description: Convert flow rate between L/min, L/s, m³/h, GPM (US), CFM and ft³/s using exact volume definitions.

faqs.a: The US liquid gallon is defined as exactly 231 cubic inches = 3.785411784 litres, so 1 GPM = 3.785411784 L/min.
faqs.q: How many litres per minute is 1 GPM?

faqs.a: 1 cubic foot = 28.316846592 litres exactly, so 1 CFM = 28.316846592 L/min = 0.028316846592 m³/min.
faqs.q: How many litres per minute is 1 CFM?

faqs.a: Yes — these are the US liquid gallon and the international foot (0.3048 m exactly). The UK imperial gallon (4.54609 L) is not used here.
faqs.q: Are US or imperial gallons used?
